rules.title: H.3744 – Boston rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections home-rule petition (193rd General Court)
rules.requirement: A home-rule petition to let Boston adopt rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections was filed but accompanied a study order on 9/9/2024 and was not enacted. No Boston rent stabilization authority results from it.
rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.key_value: home-rule petition sent to study order (not enacted)

no_rule_findings.finding: The Boston rent stabilization home-rule petition H.3744 accompanied a study order and died, so no Boston rent stabilization authority was enacted via this bill.
The Boston petition for tenant eviction protections (H.3744) was sent to a study order, so no Boston just-cause eviction law was enacted through it.

parsed.doc_summary: Bill history page for H.3744 (193rd Court), a Boston home-rule petition for rent stabilization and eviction protections. It accompanied a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024 and did not pass.
